iWant: Squire's own browser, in a window I can watch and take over, that never gives a website my details or signs in to my accounts without my yes
soThat: Squire can use the web for me without exposing me
description: The driven browser runs in its own visible window, separate from the Squire owner's browser.
title: A browser it drives: none of the Squire owner's details, no sign-in without a yes

acceptanceCriteria.description: Squire never gives a website the Squire owner's details.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A website that asks for personal details (name, email address, postal address, phone number, card number)
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire's browser fills in the page
acceptanceCriteria.then: The browser supplies none of the Squire owner's details.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Squire's browser signs in to the Squire owner's accounts only on their yes, and the Squire owner can watch it and take over.
acceptanceCriteria.given: Squire's browser reaches a sign-in page and the Squire owner has not said yes to that sign-in
acceptanceCriteria.then: The browser stops and does not sign in until the yes; its window is visible on the Mac, and the Squire owner can take over in it.
